messages:
Maya Patel: Opening thread to capture postmortem follow-ups from the GPU surge on 3/12 — need clear owners/timelines for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom planning. TL;DR: recurring small surges + one big throttle.
Riley Chen: Thanks Maya. I can own scheduler tuning items. Will need current config diffs and a test window.
Jordan Lee: I can take quota/backstop requests with finance approval runbook. @Riley we should coordinate on burst quotas.
Samir Gupta: Noted. I'll take monitoring + anomaly detection work (metrics, alert thresholds, runbook triggers).
Elena Voss: I'll handle the headroom planning doc and run the capacity simulation for Q2.
Maya Patel: Great. Primary action items: 1) Scheduler tuning (owner: Riley) 2) Quota/backstop policy + request flow (owner: Jordan) 3) Headroom buffer + sim (owner: Elena) 4) Alerting + regression tests (owner: Samir) 5) Follow-up doc + status cadence (owner: Maya). Propose due dates: 2w for scheduler, 1w for quota proposal, 2w for sim, 1w for alerts. Agree? :calendar:
Riley Chen: Agree to 2w. Will prototype patch and smoke-test on staging Thu. Patch preview below.
Riley Chen: ```yaml
scheduler: 
  max_batch_inflight: 60
  dynamic_backoff_ms: 25
  gpu_headroom_pct: 10  # temporary bump
  eviction_threshold_pct: 95
```
Jordan Lee: For quota: I'll open a formal quota request to cloud provider and an internal temporary backstop pool (reserved-gpu-temp). Creating INF ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521
Samir Gupta: For alerts, I'll add a new composite alert that triggers when (GPU_util > 92% AND queue_len > 30) for 3m. Also adding a synthetic load test to the weekly canary.
Elena Voss: Headroom sim: running two scenarios (sustained 30% delta in seq len, and burst 5x traffic for 30s). I'll attach results to the doc and recommend buffer percent.
Maya Patel: Ownership + timeline checklist (quick):
- Riley: scheduler PR + staging test — due 2543824676 (2w)
- Jordan: quota request + backstop plan — due 2543549476 (1w)
- Elena: headroom simulation + recommendation — due 2543824676 (2w)
- Samir: alerting + regression tests — due 2543549476 (1w)
- Maya: consolidate follow-up doc + weekly status — start now, first status on 2543300000 (3d)
Riley Chen: @Maya ping — quick Q: if we bump gpu_headroom_pct to 10 temporarily, do we want autoscaler override or scheduler-level reserve?
Jordan Lee: I'd prefer scheduler reserve first (faster), and request larger quota in parallel. Backstop pool as fallback.
Samir Gupta: Logging note: add a trace_id for autoscale events so postmortem correlation is easier. I'll update the alert templates.
Elena Voss: Also recommending a daily headroom metric snapshot retained 30d to spot regressions.
Maya Patel: Good call. Samir - can you add a short playbook section for rollback steps if scheduler change causes regressions? 
Samir Gupta: Yup. Plan: revert PR, scale down new pools, and re-route traffic to fallback model variants. I'll include commands.
Samir Gupta: ```bash
# revert scheduler config
kubectl -n infra apply -f scheduler-config-previous.yaml
# scale reserved pool down
redwoodctl compute resize --pool reserved-gpu-temp --replicas 0
```
Riley Chen: I'll keep PR small. If staging looks good, we can canary to 10% traffic for 2h. Samir, can you run the synthetic load during that canary?
Samir Gupta: Yep — schedule synthetic at 10:30 PT on canary day.
Jordan Lee: Jordan here — raising one policy question: how big should the temporary backstop pool be? My proposal: 20% of peak 7d moving average or a hard 50 GPUs, whichever is smaller. Putting that in the ticket.
Elena Voss: I'll feed peak numbers into Jordan's ticket. Also will surface cost estimate for the 20% buffer to finance.
Maya Patel: Weekly cadence: quick 15m triage standup Fridays for 3 weeks after rollout. Who can't make Fridays?
Jordan Lee: Friday ok.
Riley Chen: Friday ok.
Samir Gupta: Friday ok.
Elena Voss: Friday ok.
Maya Patel: OK. I'll create the follow-up doc and link all tickets. Next steps: owners create PR/ticket and update this thread with links. Ops-bot: please post a reminder in #incidents 48h before each due date.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2543549476 (quota due) and 2543824676 (scheduler/headroom due).
Riley Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scheduler/pull/812 — adding test plan.
Jordan Lee: INF-4521 created and shared with finance. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521
Samir Gupta: Alert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/455
Elena Voss: Headroom sim results uploaded to doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/headroom-sim-3-12 — preliminary recommends 12% buffer.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the Friday triage. If anyone hits blockers, ping here and @oncall.
Riley Chen: ack :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: ack
Samir Gupta: ack
Elena Voss: ack
Maya Patel: closing thread for now, will post the consolidated follow-ups in this thread by EOD.
